# Noibu

Skills that teach agents to work with Noibu. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [Noibu/ai-plugin](https://github.com/Noibu/ai-plugin), at commit `9fa2edd`.

Work with Noibu error and performance data for e-commerce sites.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Noibu**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Noibu**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install noibu@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

8 skills: `accessibility-audit`, `build-business-context`, `checkout-analysis`, `product-analysis`, `querying-noibu-data`, `segment-analysis`, `store-pulse`, `tech-diagnosis`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
